explanation: Mathlib has `Bialgebra.IsPrimitiveElem.antipode` in `Mathlib/RingTheory/HopfAlgebra/Primitive.lean`, but it only covers primitive elements (the special case with endpoints 1), not the general skew-primitive statement with arbitrary g and h. Searches for skew-primitive antipode results and related antipode/comultiplication declarations found no matching general theorem.
